sn8.10:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rājagaha on the Black Rock on the Isigili Slope, together with a great Saṅgha of bhikkhus, with five hundred bhikkhus all of whom were arahants.
sn8.10:1.2: Thereupon the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna searched their minds with his own mind [and saw that they were] released, without acquisitions.
sn8.10:1.3: Then it occurred to the Venerable Vaṅgīsa:
sn8.10:1.4: “The Blessed One is dwelling at Rājagaha on the Black Rock on the Isigili Slope…
sn8.10:1.5: Thereupon the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna has searched their minds with his own mind [and seen that they are] released, without acquisitions.
sn8.10:1.6: Let me extol the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna in the Blessed One’s presence with suitable verses.”
sn8.10:2.1: Then the Venerable Vaṅgīsa rose from his seat, arranged his upper robe over one shoulder, and, raising his joined hands in reverential salutation towards the Blessed One, said to him:
sn8.10:2.2: “An inspiration has come to me, Blessed One! An inspiration has come to me, Fortunate One!”
sn8.10:2.4: Then the Venerable Vaṅgīsa extolled the Venerable Mahāmoggallāna in the Blessed One’s presence with suitable verses:
sn8.10:3.1: “While the sage is seated on the mountain slope,
sn8.10:3.2: Gone to the far shore of suffering,
sn8.10:3.3: His disciples sit in attendance on him,
sn8.10:3.4: Triple-knowledge men who have left Death behind.
sn8.10:4.2: Encompassed their minds with his own,
sn8.10:4.3: And searching [he came to see] their minds:
sn8.10:5.3: The sage perfect in all respects,
sn8.10:5.4: Gone to the far shore of suffering.
